summary: AIR Global PLC (NASDAQ: AIIR) filed a Form 6-K on July 29, 2026, announcing a $20 million strategic equity investment in Greentank Innovations Corp. via preferred shares, at a pre-money valuation of ~$170 million. AIR also obtained a warrant to increase its stake by up to 20% over 24 months at a $250 million valuation, implying a potential future premium. The deal includes a board nomination right, enhanced commercial terms, technology access, and long-term supply assurances. No break fee or advisor is named. The investment deepens an existing 2023 partnership, focusing on Crown Switch vapes. Watch for regulatory updates and the exercise of the warrant, with risk-arb focusing on execution and valuation milestones.
